rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The AICC website says 'On 28th May 2005 Smt. Sonia Gandhi was elected as President of the Indian National Congress by overwhelming support from across the country from all states.'

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: A photograph caption on the same page shows Shri Oscar Fernandes, Chairman of the Central Election Authority, 'declaring that Smt. Sonia Gandhi has been duly elected as the President of the Indian National Congress'; another shows her speaking to Congress workers 'on the occasion of her election as Congress President'.
